summary: Sangrix Inc., a Singapore-domiciled Nasdaq-listed foreign private issuer formerly known as Bit Origin Ltd, furnished a Form 6-K reporting that it sold 3,000,000 Dogecoin on September 7, 2026, in two 1,500,000 DOGE transactions at a weighted average price of approximately US$0.089221667 per DOGE, generating gross proceeds of roughly US$267,665, before fees. Proceeds fund working capital and planned AI infrastructure expenditures. Management said the DOGE price recovery improved financial flexibility and that further sales of remaining holdings will be evaluated opportunistically. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or ownership change applies; this is an ordinary digital-asset monetization update, not a special situation.
